name: trustweave
description: TrustWeave monorepo: simulation backend, Next.js dashboard and Electron wrapper

scripts.app: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.app:smoke: npm --prefix frontend run build && TRUSTWEAVE_SMOKE=1 npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.package:app: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop run package
scripts.package:app:dir: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix desktop run package:dir
